CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_archive_receipt (  receipt_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(receipt_id)=64),  archive_locator TEXT NOT NULL,  manifest_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(manifest_hash)=64),  dependency_graph_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(dependency_graph_hash)=64),  verified_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(verified_at>0),  replay_verified INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(replay_verified=1),  manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(manifest_json AS BLOB))<=65536) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_blob (  blob_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(blob_hash)=64),  byte_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_count>=0),  codec TEXT NOT NULL,  storage_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(storage_state IN ('LOCAL','ARCHIVED')),  local_locator TEXT,  archive_receipt_id TEXT REFERENCES su1_archive_receipt(receipt_id),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  CHECK((storage_state='LOCAL' AND local_locator IS NOT NULL) OR        (storage_state='ARCHIVED' AND local_locator IS NULL AND archive_receipt_id IS NOT NULL)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_relation_asset (  asset_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(asset_hash)=64),  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('PRIMITIVE','MACRO','STATE_TRANSITION')),  typed_contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(typed_contract_hash)=64),  definition_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  material_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(material_status='MATERIAL'),  available_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(available_through_sequence>=0),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_train_protocol (  protocol_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(protocol_hash)=64),  program_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_program(program_hash),  dataset_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(dataset_hash)=64),  split_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(split_hash)=64),  protocol_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(protocol_json AS BLOB))<=65536),  train_first_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  train_last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  validation_first_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  validation_last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  target_contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(target_contract_hash)=64),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  CHECK(train_first_sequence<=train_last_sequence AND train_last_sequence<validation_first_sequence        AND validation_first_sequence<=validation_last_sequence) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_model_artifact (  artifact_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(artifact_hash)=64),  protocol_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_train_protocol(protocol_hash),  program_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_program(program_hash),  model_kind TEXT NOT NULL,  encoder_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(encoder_hash)=64),  weights_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  trained_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(trained_through_sequence>=0),  training_report_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_strategy_version (  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(strategy_id)=64),  codec TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(codec='SU1'),  program_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_program(program_hash),  artifact_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_model_artifact(artifact_hash),  selector_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(selector_hash)=64),  calibration_hash TEXT REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  calibration_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(calibration_state IN ('MISSING','FROZEN')),  action_contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(action_contract_hash)=64),  state_initial_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_initial_hash)=64),  created_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(created_sequence>=0),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,        strategy_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CANDIDATE' CHECK(strategy_role IN ('CANDIDATE','NULL_BASELINE','NULL_CONTROL')),  CHECK((calibration_state='MISSING' AND calibration_hash IS NULL) OR        (calibration_state='FROZEN' AND calibration_hash IS NOT NULL)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_alpha_root (  singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton=1),  global_alpha REAL NOT NULL CHECK(global_alpha>0 AND global_alpha<=0.05),  registration_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(registration_hash)=64),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_eval_cohort (  cohort_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(cohort_id)=64),  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  parent_strategy_id TEXT REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(claim_id)=64),  evidence_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_role IN ('RESEARCH_FUTURE','CONFIRM','CALIBRATION_FIT','CALIBRATION_VALIDATION')),  claim_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(claim_kind IN ('PARENT_CHILD','VS_NULL_BASELINE','NULL_CONTROL')),  registered_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  first_issue INTEGER NOT NULL,  planned_opportunities INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(planned_opportunities BETWEEN 1 AND 1000000),  protocol_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(protocol_hash)=64),  protocol_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(protocol_json AS BLOB))<=65536),  family_root_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(family_root_hash)=64),  family_alpha REAL NOT NULL CHECK(family_alpha>0 AND family_alpha<1),  global_claim_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(global_claim_ordinal>0),  look_schedule_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(look_schedule_json AS BLOB))<=16384),  baseline_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(baseline_hash)=64),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  FOREIGN KEY(family_root_hash,family_alpha) REFERENCES su1_family_budget(family_root_hash,family_alpha),  UNIQUE(family_root_hash,global_claim_ordinal),  UNIQUE(claim_id),  CHECK(parent_strategy_id IS NULL OR parent_strategy_id<>strategy_id),  CHECK(evidence_role<>'CONFIRM' OR parent_strategy_id IS NOT NULL) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_opportunity (  opportunity_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(opportunity_id)=64),  cohort_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_eval_cohort(cohort_id),  target_issue INTEGER NOT NULL,  sequence_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_ordinal>0),  opportunity_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(opportunity_ordinal>0),  declared_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  deadline_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  source_epoch TEXT NOT NULL,  eligibility_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(eligibility_hash)=64),  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('RESEARCH_FUTURE','CONFIRM','CALIBRATION_FIT','CALIBRATION_VALIDATION')),  UNIQUE(cohort_id,target_issue), UNIQUE(cohort_id,opportunity_ordinal),  CHECK(declared_at<deadline_at) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_look_plan (  cohort_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_eval_cohort(cohort_id),  look_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(look_ordinal>0),  planned_opportunities INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(planned_opportunities>0),  schedule_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_hash)=64),  PRIMARY KEY(cohort_id,look_ordinal),  UNIQUE(cohort_id,look_ordinal,planned_opportunities) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_prediction (  prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(prediction_id)=64),  opportunity_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_opportunity(opportunity_id),  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  snapshot_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_snapshot(snapshot_hash),  target_issue INTEGER NOT NULL,  captured_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  n1 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(n1 BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  n2 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(n2 BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  n3 INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(n3 BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  prediction_mask INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(prediction_mask BETWEEN 1 AND 1023),  raw_k3_score REAL NOT NULL CHECK(raw_k3_score>=0 AND raw_k3_score<=1),  selected_hit_p REAL CHECK(selected_hit_p>=0 AND selected_hit_p<=1),  calibration_hash TEXT REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  probability_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  period_state_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash) CHECK(length(period_state_hash)=64),  trained_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  input_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  record_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(record_hash)=64),  UNIQUE(opportunity_id,strategy_id),  CHECK(n1<n2 AND n2<n3),  CHECK(prediction_mask=((1 << (n1-1)) | (1 << (n2-1)) | (1 << (n3-1)))),  CHECK((selected_hit_p IS NULL AND calibration_hash IS NULL) OR        (selected_hit_p IS NOT NULL AND calibration_hash IS NOT NULL)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_settlement (  settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(settlement_id)=64),  prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES su1_prediction(prediction_id),  target_issue INTEGER NOT NULL,  canonical_draw_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical_draw_hash)=64),  legacy_settlement_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(legacy_settlement_hash)=64),  actual INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(actual BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  hit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hit IN (0,1)),  label_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(label_hash)=64),  committed_at INTEGER NOT NULL );
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_pending_settlement (  prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES su1_prediction(prediction_id),  target_issue INTEGER NOT NULL,  enqueued_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_outbox (  event_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  event_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(event_type IN ('FROZEN','SETTLED')),  prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_prediction(prediction_id),  settlement_id TEXT REFERENCES su1_settlement(settlement_id),  source_record_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_record_hash)=64),  state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','LEASED','DONE','DEAD')),  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count>=0),  lease_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(lease_generation>=0),  lease_owner TEXT,  lease_until INTEGER,  retry_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  CHECK((event_type='FROZEN' AND settlement_id IS NULL) OR        (event_type='SETTLED' AND settlement_id IS NOT NULL)),  CHECK((state='LEASED' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR        (state<>'LEASED' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_feedback (  feedback_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(feedback_hash)=64),  settlement_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_settlement(settlement_id),  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('RESIDUAL','COVERAGE','DRIFT','CALIBRATION','SYNERGY','DATA_QUALITY')),  diagnostic_contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(diagnostic_contract_hash)=64),  payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  UNIQUE(settlement_id,kind,diagnostic_contract_hash) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_research_task (  task_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(task_id)=64),  intent_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(intent_hash)=64),  feedback_hash TEXT REFERENCES su1_feedback(feedback_hash),  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('DISCOVER','TRAIN','CALIBRATE','COMPARE','FUSE','REPLAY')),  input_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(input_hash)=64),  boundary_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(boundary_sequence>=0),  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('PENDING','LEASED','WAITING','COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED')),  checkpoint_hash TEXT REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  output_hash TEXT REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash),  lease_generation INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(lease_generation>=0),  lease_owner TEXT,  lease_until INTEGER,  attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempt_count>=0),  cpu_budget_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(cpu_budget_ms BETWEEN 1 AND 60000),  byte_budget INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_budget BETWEEN 1 AND 33554432),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',  CHECK((state='LEASED' AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL) OR        (state<>'LEASED' AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)),  CHECK(state<>'COMPLETED' OR output_hash IS NOT NULL) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_lineage (  parent_strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  child_strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_research_task(task_id),  operation_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(operation_hash)=64),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  PRIMARY KEY(parent_strategy_id,child_strategy_id,task_id),  CHECK(parent_strategy_id<>child_strategy_id) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_evidence_look (  evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(evidence_hash)=64),  cohort_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_eval_cohort(cohort_id),  claim_id TEXT NOT NULL,  global_claim_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(global_claim_ordinal>0),  look_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(look_ordinal>0),  protocol_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(protocol_hash)=64),  planned_opportunities INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(planned_opportunities>0),  paired_n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(paired_n>=0),  parent_missing_n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(parent_missing_n>=0),  child_missing_n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(child_missing_n>=0),  unpaired_n INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(unpaired_n>=0),  parent_hits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(parent_hits>=0),  child_hits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(child_hits>=0),  child_only_wins INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(child_only_wins>=0),  parent_only_wins INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(parent_only_wins>=0),  paired_delta REAL,  conservative_mean REAL NOT NULL CHECK(conservative_mean BETWEEN -1 AND 1),        bound_radius REAL NOT NULL CHECK(bound_radius>0),  lower_bound REAL NOT NULL CHECK(lower_bound BETWEEN -1 AND 1),  allocated_alpha REAL NOT NULL CHECK(allocated_alpha>0 AND allocated_alpha<1),  cumulative_alpha_spent REAL NOT NULL CHECK(cumulative_alpha_spent>0 AND cumulative_alpha_spent<1),  coverage REAL NOT NULL CHECK(coverage>=0 AND coverage<=1),  result_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(result_state IN ('INSUFFICIENT','FAIL','PASS')),  source_chain_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_chain_hash)=64),  metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(metrics_json AS BLOB))<=65536),  recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  FOREIGN KEY(cohort_id,look_ordinal,planned_opportunities)   REFERENCES su1_look_plan(cohort_id,look_ordinal,planned_opportunities),  UNIQUE(cohort_id,claim_id,look_ordinal),  CHECK(paired_n+unpaired_n=planned_opportunities),  CHECK(parent_missing_n<=unpaired_n AND child_missing_n<=unpaired_n        AND parent_missing_n+child_missing_n>=unpaired_n),  CHECK(parent_hits<=paired_n AND child_hits<=paired_n),  CHECK(child_only_wins+parent_only_wins<=paired_n),  CHECK(child_hits-parent_hits=child_only_wins-parent_only_wins),  CHECK(result_state<>'PASS' OR lower_bound>0) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_certificate (  certificate_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(certificate_id)=64),  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES su1_evidence_look(evidence_hash),      baseline_evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_evidence_look(evidence_hash),  policy_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(policy_hash)=64),  source_chain_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_chain_hash)=64),  issued_at INTEGER NOT NULL,    expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  CHECK(expires_at>issued_at) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_certificate_revocation (  certificate_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES su1_certificate(certificate_id),  reason_code TEXT NOT NULL,  evidence_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(evidence_hash)=64),  revoked_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_mainline_binding (  target_issue INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  certificate_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_certificate(certificate_id),  prediction_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES su1_prediction(prediction_id),  adapter_contract_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(adapter_contract_hash)=64),  original_owner_receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(original_owner_receipt_hash)=64),  bound_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_dependency (  source_kind TEXT NOT NULL,  source_id TEXT NOT NULL,  target_kind TEXT NOT NULL,  target_id TEXT NOT NULL,  reason TEXT NOT NULL,  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  PRIMARY KEY(source_kind,source_id,target_kind,target_id) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_retention_pin (  pin_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(pin_id)=64),  object_kind TEXT NOT NULL,  object_id TEXT NOT NULL,  reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reason IN ('ACTIVE_STRATEGY','OPEN_COHORT','PENDING_EVENT','LEASED_TASK','REPLAY','MAINLINE')),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  released_at INTEGER,  CHECK(released_at IS NULL OR released_at>=created_at) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_runtime_checkpoint (  checkpoint_key TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,  cursor_issue INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  deferred_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(deferred_count>=0),  last_error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' );

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS su1_opportunity_outcome_issue ON su1_opportunity_outcome(target_issue,opportunity_id);

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_model_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_model_artifact BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_train_protocol p WHERE p.protocol_hash=NEW.protocol_hash   AND p.program_hash=NEW.program_hash AND p.validation_last_sequence<=NEW.trained_through_sequence)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_MODEL_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_strategy_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_strategy_version BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_model_artifact m WHERE m.artifact_hash=NEW.artifact_hash   AND m.program_hash=NEW.program_hash AND m.trained_through_sequence<=NEW.created_sequence)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_STRATEGY_ARTIFACT_MISMATCH') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_opportunity_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_opportunity BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_eval_cohort c WHERE c.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id   AND c.evidence_role=NEW.role AND NEW.sequence_ordinal>c.registered_sequence   AND NEW.opportunity_ordinal<=c.planned_opportunities AND NEW.target_issue>=c.first_issue)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_OPPORTUNITY_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.role='CONFIRM' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_look_plan WHERE cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PLAN_NOT_REGISTERED') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_cohort_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_eval_cohort BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id   AND created_sequence<=NEW.registered_sequence)  OR (NEW.parent_strategy_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_strategy_version   WHERE strategy_id=NEW.parent_strategy_id AND created_sequence<=NEW.registered_sequence))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_COHORT_STRATEGY_NOT_FROZEN') END;      SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.evidence_role='CONFIRM' AND NEW.global_claim_ordinal<>(SELECT coalesce(max(global_claim_ordinal),0)+1   FROM su1_eval_cohort WHERE family_root_hash=NEW.family_root_hash AND evidence_role='CONFIRM')  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_GLOBAL_CLAIM_ORDINAL') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.evidence_role<>'CONFIRM' AND NEW.global_claim_ordinal<>(SELECT coalesce(max(global_claim_ordinal),999999)+1   FROM su1_eval_cohort WHERE family_root_hash=NEW.family_root_hash AND evidence_role<>'CONFIRM')  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_RESEARCH_CLAIM_ORDINAL') END;      SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.parent_strategy_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT (    (NEW.claim_kind='PARENT_CHILD'     AND (SELECT strategy_role FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id)='CANDIDATE'     AND (SELECT strategy_role FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.parent_strategy_id)='CANDIDATE')   OR (NEW.claim_kind='VS_NULL_BASELINE'     AND (SELECT strategy_role FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id)='CANDIDATE'     AND (SELECT strategy_role FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.parent_strategy_id)='NULL_BASELINE')   OR (NEW.claim_kind='NULL_CONTROL'     AND (SELECT strategy_role FROM su1_strategy_version WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id) IN ('NULL_BASELINE','NULL_CONTROL')))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_CLAIM_KIND_ROLE_MISMATCH') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.parent_strategy_id IS NULL AND NEW.claim_kind<>'PARENT_CHILD'  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_CLAIM_KIND_REQUIRES_COMPARATOR') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_family_budget_allocation BEFORE INSERT ON su1_family_budget BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.family_ordinal<>(SELECT coalesce(max(family_ordinal),0)+1 FROM su1_family_budget)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_FAMILY_ORDINAL') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_alpha_root WHERE singleton=1   AND NEW.family_alpha<=global_alpha/(1.0*NEW.family_ordinal*(NEW.family_ordinal+1))+0.000000000001)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_FAMILY_ALPHA_EXCEEDS_GLOBAL_ROOT') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_look_plan_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_look_plan BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity WHERE cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id)  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_eval_cohort WHERE cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id   AND NEW.planned_opportunities<=planned_opportunities)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PLAN_MUST_PRECEDE_OPPORTUNITY') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_prediction_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_prediction BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_runtime_control WHERE singleton=1 AND mode<>'DISABLED')  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_DISABLED') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity o JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_hash=NEW.snapshot_hash   JOIN su1_strategy_version v ON v.strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id   JOIN su1_model_artifact m ON m.artifact_hash=v.artifact_hash   WHERE o.opportunity_id=NEW.opportunity_id AND o.target_issue=NEW.target_issue   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity_outcome a WHERE a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id)   AND s.target_issue=NEW.target_issue AND s.source_epoch=o.source_epoch   AND NEW.captured_at>=s.captured_at AND NEW.captured_at>=o.declared_at AND NEW.captured_at<o.deadline_at   AND NEW.captured_at<s.target_open_time AND v.created_sequence<o.sequence_ordinal   AND NEW.trained_through_sequence=m.trained_through_sequence   AND NEW.trained_through_sequence<o.sequence_ordinal AND NEW.input_through_sequence<o.sequence_ordinal   AND NEW.input_through_sequence>=NEW.trained_through_sequence   AND (NEW.strategy_id=c.strategy_id OR NEW.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id)   AND ((NEW.calibration_hash IS NULL AND NEW.selected_hit_p IS NULL) OR        (v.calibration_state='FROZEN' AND NEW.calibration_hash=v.calibration_hash)))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_FREEZE_BINDING_OR_TIME') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_freeze_event AFTER INSERT ON su1_prediction BEGIN  INSERT INTO su1_pending_settlement(prediction_id,target_issue,enqueued_at)  VALUES(NEW.prediction_id,NEW.target_issue,NEW.captured_at);  INSERT INTO su1_outbox(event_id,event_type,prediction_id,source_record_hash,created_at,updated_at)  VALUES('FROZEN:'||NEW.prediction_id,'FROZEN',NEW.prediction_id,NEW.record_hash,NEW.captured_at,NEW.captured_at); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_settlement_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_settlement BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_settlement WHERE target_issue=NEW.target_issue   AND (canonical_draw_hash<>NEW.canonical_draw_hash OR legacy_settlement_hash<>NEW.legacy_settlement_hash))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_TARGET_TERMINAL_CONFLICT') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_prediction p JOIN su1_snapshot s ON s.snapshot_hash=p.snapshot_hash   JOIN su1_opportunity_outcome o ON o.opportunity_id=p.opportunity_id   WHERE p.prediction_id=NEW.prediction_id AND p.target_issue=NEW.target_issue   AND NEW.canonical_draw_hash=o.canonical_draw_hash AND NEW.legacy_settlement_hash=o.legacy_settlement_hash   AND NEW.committed_at>=o.completed_at   AND NEW.committed_at>=s.target_open_time   AND NEW.hit=CASE WHEN NEW.actual IN (p.n1,p.n2,p.n3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_SETTLEMENT_BINDING') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_opportunity_outcome_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_opportunity_outcome BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity o WHERE o.opportunity_id=NEW.opportunity_id   AND o.target_issue=NEW.target_issue AND o.source_epoch=NEW.source_epoch AND NEW.opened_at>=o.deadline_at)  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity_outcome WHERE target_issue=NEW.target_issue   AND (canonical_draw_hash<>NEW.canonical_draw_hash OR legacy_settlement_hash<>NEW.legacy_settlement_hash))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_OPPORTUNITY_OUTCOME_BINDING') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_settlement_event AFTER INSERT ON su1_settlement BEGIN  DELETE FROM su1_pending_settlement WHERE prediction_id=NEW.prediction_id;  INSERT INTO su1_outbox(event_id,event_type,prediction_id,settlement_id,source_record_hash,created_at,updated_at)  VALUES('SETTLED:'||NEW.settlement_id,'SETTLED',NEW.prediction_id,NEW.settlement_id,NEW.label_hash,NEW.committed_at,NEW.committed_at); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_pending_settlement_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON su1_pending_settlement WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_settlement WHERE prediction_id=OLD.prediction_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_PENDING_REQUIRES_SETTLEMENT'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_pending_settlement_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_pending_settlement BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_PENDING_IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_look_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_evidence_look BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.planned_opportunities<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_opportunity_outcome a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND a.completed_at<=NEW.recorded_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_CANONICAL_PREFIX_NOT_COMPLETE') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN abs(NEW.cumulative_alpha_spent-NEW.allocated_alpha-   (SELECT coalesce(sum(allocated_alpha),0) FROM su1_evidence_look WHERE cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id))>0.000000000001  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_ALPHA_LEDGER') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_opportunity o JOIN su1_prediction p ON p.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id   LEFT JOIN su1_settlement s ON s.prediction_id=p.prediction_id AND s.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities AND s.settlement_id IS NULL)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PENDING_SETTLEMENT') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_eval_cohort c WHERE c.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id   AND c.claim_id=NEW.claim_id AND c.protocol_hash=NEW.protocol_hash   AND c.global_claim_ordinal=NEW.global_claim_ordinal   AND NEW.planned_opportunities<=c.planned_opportunities   AND NEW.allocated_alpha<=c.family_alpha /       (1.0*c.global_claim_ordinal*(c.global_claim_ordinal+1)*NEW.look_ordinal*(NEW.look_ordinal+1))   AND NEW.cumulative_alpha_spent<=c.family_alpha)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PROTOCOL_OR_ALPHA') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.planned_opportunities<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity   WHERE cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities AND deadline_at<=NEW.recorded_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_OPPORTUNITY_DENOMINATOR') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_look_derived_counts BEFORE INSERT ON su1_evidence_look BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.paired_n<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_prediction a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND a.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sa ON sa.prediction_id=a.prediction_id   JOIN su1_prediction b ON b.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND b.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sb ON sb.prediction_id=b.prediction_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND sa.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sb.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PAIRED_COUNT') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.parent_missing_n<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   LEFT JOIN su1_prediction p ON p.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND p.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   LEFT JOIN su1_settlement s ON s.prediction_id=p.prediction_id AND s.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities AND s.settlement_id IS NULL)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_PARENT_MISSING') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.child_missing_n<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   LEFT JOIN su1_prediction p ON p.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND p.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   LEFT JOIN su1_settlement s ON s.prediction_id=p.prediction_id AND s.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities AND s.settlement_id IS NULL)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_CHILD_MISSING') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.parent_hits<>(SELECT coalesce(sum(sa.hit),0) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_prediction a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND a.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sa ON sa.prediction_id=a.prediction_id   JOIN su1_prediction b ON b.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND b.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sb ON sb.prediction_id=b.prediction_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND sa.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sb.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at)  OR NEW.child_hits<>(SELECT coalesce(sum(sb.hit),0) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_prediction a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND a.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sa ON sa.prediction_id=a.prediction_id   JOIN su1_prediction b ON b.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND b.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sb ON sb.prediction_id=b.prediction_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND sa.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sb.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_HIT_COUNTS') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.child_only_wins<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_prediction a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND a.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sa ON sa.prediction_id=a.prediction_id   JOIN su1_prediction b ON b.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND b.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sb ON sb.prediction_id=b.prediction_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND sa.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sb.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sa.hit=0 AND sb.hit=1)  OR NEW.parent_only_wins<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_opportunity o   JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=o.cohort_id   JOIN su1_prediction a ON a.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND a.strategy_id=c.parent_strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sa ON sa.prediction_id=a.prediction_id   JOIN su1_prediction b ON b.opportunity_id=o.opportunity_id AND b.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   JOIN su1_settlement sb ON sb.prediction_id=b.prediction_id   WHERE o.cohort_id=NEW.cohort_id AND o.opportunity_ordinal<=NEW.planned_opportunities    AND sa.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sb.committed_at<=NEW.recorded_at AND sa.hit=1 AND sb.hit=0)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_DISCORDANT_PAIRS') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN abs(NEW.conservative_mean-   (1.0*(NEW.child_only_wins-NEW.parent_only_wins-NEW.unpaired_n)/NEW.planned_opportunities))>0.000000001   OR abs(NEW.coverage-(1.0*NEW.paired_n/NEW.planned_opportunities))>0.000000001   OR (NEW.paired_n=0 AND NEW.paired_delta IS NOT NULL)   OR (NEW.paired_n>0 AND (NEW.paired_delta IS NULL OR abs(NEW.paired_delta-      (1.0*(NEW.child_hits-NEW.parent_hits)/NEW.paired_n))>0.000000001))   OR abs(NEW.lower_bound-max(-1.0,NEW.conservative_mean-NEW.bound_radius))>0.000000001  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LOOK_DERIVED_METRICS') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_certificate_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_certificate BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_evidence_look e JOIN su1_eval_cohort c ON c.cohort_id=e.cohort_id   JOIN su1_strategy_version v ON v.strategy_id=c.strategy_id   WHERE e.evidence_hash=NEW.evidence_hash AND c.strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id   AND v.strategy_role='CANDIDATE' AND c.claim_kind IN ('PARENT_CHILD','VS_NULL_BASELINE')   AND c.evidence_role='CONFIRM' AND e.result_state='PASS' AND e.lower_bound>0   AND e.source_chain_hash=NEW.source_chain_hash AND NEW.issued_at>=e.recorded_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_CERTIFICATE_EVIDENCE') END; CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_campaign (  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(campaign_id)=64),  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('HISTORY_REPLAY','LIVE_REFRESH')),  data_through_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(data_through_sequence>0),  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(config_hash)=64),  config_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(config_json AS BLOB))<=65536),  started_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  finished_at INTEGER,  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('RUNNING','DONE','FAILED')),  programs_evaluated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(programs_evaluated>=0),  CHECK((status='RUNNING' AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (status<>'RUNNING' AND finished_at>=started_at)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_era (  era_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(era_id)=64),  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('DEV','VAL','SEALED')),  first_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  last_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,  UNIQUE(campaign_id,kind),  CHECK(first_sequence<=last_sequence) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_sealed_open (  era_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES su1_era(era_id),  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  opened_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  result_hash TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_blob(blob_hash) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_research_pool (  entry_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(length(entry_id)=64),  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  arm TEXT NOT NULL,  born_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(born_sequence>0),  prior_fitness REAL NOT NULL,  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','RETIRED')),  retired_sequence INTEGER,  retire_reason TEXT,  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  CHECK((state='ACTIVE' AND retired_sequence IS NULL AND retire_reason IS NULL) OR        (state='RETIRED' AND retired_sequence>=born_sequence AND retire_reason IS NOT NULL)) );
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS su1_pool_one_active ON su1_research_pool(strategy_id) WHERE state='ACTIVE';

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow (  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  sequence_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_ordinal>0),  day_key INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(day_key BETWEEN 20200101 AND 21001231),  position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(position BETWEEN 1 AND 10),  number_mask INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(number_mask BETWEEN 7 AND 896),  captured_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  target_open_time INTEGER NOT NULL,  hit INTEGER CHECK(hit IN (0,1)),  settled_at INTEGER,  PRIMARY KEY(strategy_id,sequence_ordinal),  CHECK(captured_at<target_open_time),  CHECK(((number_mask>>0)&1)+((number_mask>>1)&1)+((number_mask>>2)&1)+((number_mask>>3)&1)+((number_mask>>4)&1)       +((number_mask>>5)&1)+((number_mask>>6)&1)+((number_mask>>7)&1)+((number_mask>>8)&1)+((number_mask>>9)&1)=3),  CHECK((hit IS NULL AND settled_at IS NULL) OR (hit IS NOT NULL AND settled_at>=target_open_time)) ) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow_pending ON su1_live_shadow(sequence_ordinal) WHERE hit IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_daily (  strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_strategy_version(strategy_id),  day_key INTEGER NOT NULL,  actions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(actions>=0),  hits INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(hits>=0 AND hits<=actions),  periods_observed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(periods_observed>=actions),  closed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,  PRIMARY KEY(strategy_id,day_key) ) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_macro (  macro_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(macro_id LIKE 'M%' AND length(macro_id)=11),  canonical_text TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(canonical_text) BETWEEN 3 AND 4096),  support INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(support>=2),  best_fitness REAL NOT NULL,  born_campaign TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  last_campaign TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('ACTIVE','RETIRED')) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_emergent_family (  family_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY CHECK(family_id='EMERGENT:'||macro_id),  macro_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES su1_macro(macro_id),  created_campaign TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_director_state (  campaign_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES su1_campaign(campaign_id),  state_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(CAST(state_json AS BLOB))<=65536),  state_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(state_hash)=64) );

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_era_order BEFORE INSERT ON su1_era BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_era e WHERE e.campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id AND (    (NEW.kind='VAL' AND e.kind='DEV' AND e.last_sequence>=NEW.first_sequence) OR    (NEW.kind='SEALED' AND e.kind IN ('DEV','VAL') AND e.last_sequence>=NEW.first_sequence) OR    (NEW.kind='DEV' AND e.kind IN ('VAL','SEALED') AND NEW.last_sequence>=e.first_sequence) OR    (NEW.kind='VAL' AND e.kind='SEALED' AND NEW.last_sequence>=e.first_sequence)))  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_ERA_ORDER') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.last_sequence>(SELECT data_through_sequence FROM su1_campaign WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_ERA_BEYOND_DATA') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_sealed_reuse_guard BEFORE INSERT ON su1_era WHEN NEW.kind='SEALED' BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_sealed_open o JOIN su1_era e ON e.era_id=o.era_id    WHERE NEW.first_sequence<=e.last_sequence AND NEW.last_sequence>=e.first_sequence)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_SEALED_SPAN_ALREADY_OPENED') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_sealed_open_binding BEFORE INSERT ON su1_sealed_open BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_era WHERE era_id=NEW.era_id AND kind='SEALED' AND campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_SEALED_OPEN_BINDING') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_sealed_open WHERE campaign_id=NEW.campaign_id)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_ONE_SEALED_OPEN_PER_CAMPAIGN') END; END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_sealed_open_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_sealed_open BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_sealed_open_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_sealed_open BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_EVIDENCE_DELETE_DISABLED_V1'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_era_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_era BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_era_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_era BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_EVIDENCE_DELETE_DISABLED_V1'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_pool_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_research_pool BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (OLD.state='ACTIVE' AND NEW.state='RETIRED' AND NEW.entry_id=OLD.entry_id    AND NEW.strategy_id=OLD.strategy_id AND NEW.campaign_id=OLD.campaign_id AND NEW.arm=OLD.arm    AND NEW.born_sequence=OLD.born_sequence AND NEW.prior_fitness=OLD.prior_fitness AND NEW.created_at=OLD.created_at)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_POOL_TRANSITION') END; END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_pool_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_research_pool BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_EVIDENCE_DELETE_DISABLED_V1'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow_freeze BEFORE INSERT ON su1_live_shadow BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_research_pool WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id    AND state='ACTIVE' AND born_sequence<=NEW.sequence_ordinal)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_NOT_IN_ACTIVE_POOL') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.hit IS NOT NULL OR NEW.settled_at IS NOT NULL  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_FREEZE_MUST_BE_UNSETTLED') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_live_shadow WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id AND sequence_ordinal=NEW.sequence_ordinal)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_COMPARE_REPLAY_BEFORE_INSERT') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow_settle BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_live_shadow BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (OLD.hit IS NULL AND NEW.hit IS NOT NULL AND NEW.strategy_id=OLD.strategy_id    AND NEW.sequence_ordinal=OLD.sequence_ordinal AND NEW.day_key=OLD.day_key AND NEW.position=OLD.position    AND NEW.number_mask=OLD.number_mask AND NEW.captured_at=OLD.captured_at AND NEW.target_open_time=OLD.target_open_time)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_SETTLE_ONCE') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow_compact_guard BEFORE DELETE ON su1_live_shadow BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.hit IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_live_daily d WHERE d.strategy_id=OLD.strategy_id AND d.day_key=OLD.day_key)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_COMPACT_REQUIRES_DAILY') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_daily_close BEFORE INSERT ON su1_live_daily BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_live_shadow WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id AND day_key=NEW.day_key AND hit IS NULL)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_DAY_HAS_UNSETTLED') END;  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.actions<>(SELECT count(*) FROM su1_live_shadow WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id AND day_key=NEW.day_key)    OR NEW.hits<>(SELECT coalesce(sum(hit),0) FROM su1_live_shadow WHERE strategy_id=NEW.strategy_id AND day_key=NEW.day_key)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIVE_DAILY_MISMATCH') END; END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_daily_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_live_daily BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_daily_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_live_daily BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_EVIDENCE_DELETE_DISABLED_V1'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_macro_update BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_macro BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.macro_id<>OLD.macro_id OR NEW.canonical_text<>OLD.canonical_text OR NEW.born_campaign<>OLD.born_campaign    OR NEW.support<OLD.support OR (OLD.state='RETIRED' AND NEW.state='ACTIVE')  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_MACRO_IDENTITY_OR_MONOTONE') END; END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_macro_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_macro BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_EVIDENCE_DELETE_DISABLED_V1'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_emergent_family_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_emergent_family BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_IMMUTABLE'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_director_state_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_director_state BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_IMMUTABLE'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_campaign_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON su1_campaign BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT (OLD.status='RUNNING' AND NEW.status IN ('DONE','FAILED') AND NEW.campaign_id=OLD.campaign_id    AND NEW.kind=OLD.kind AND NEW.data_through_sequence=OLD.data_through_sequence AND NEW.config_hash=OLD.config_hash    AND NEW.started_at=OLD.started_at AND NEW.programs_evaluated>=OLD.programs_evaluated)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_CAMPAIGN_TRANSITION') END; END;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS su1_alpha_reservation (  reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,  origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(origin IN ('LEGACY_CP3','LEGACY_R932','SU1')),  amount REAL NOT NULL CHECK(amount>0 AND amount<=0.05),  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL );

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_alpha_reservation_cap BEFORE INSERT ON su1_alpha_reservation BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.amount+(SELECT coalesce(sum(amount),0) FROM su1_alpha_reservation)>  (SELECT global_alpha FROM su1_alpha_root WHERE singleton=1)+0.000000000001  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_LIFETIME_GLOBAL_ALPHA_EXHAUSTED') END; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_alpha_reservation_delete BEFORE DELETE ON su1_alpha_reservation BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_ALPHA_IRREVOCABLE'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS su1_live_shadow_verified_compaction BEFORE DELETE ON su1_live_shadow BEGIN  SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM su1_live_day_archive a JOIN su1_blob b ON b.blob_hash=a.payload_hash JOIN su1_archive_receipt r ON r.receipt_id=b.archive_receipt_id WHERE a.strategy_id=OLD.strategy_id AND a.day_key=OLD.day_key AND b.storage_state='ARCHIVED' AND r.replay_verified=1)  THEN RAISE(ABORT,'SU1_VERIFIED_ARCHIVE_REQUIRED') END; END;
